title: trisetaria dufourei
intro: Trisetaria dufourei, commonly known as Dufour's hair grass, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Poaceae. This plant has been found to possess several health benefits, including its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Trisetaria dufourei include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects, which make it a potential candidate for the treatment of various diseases. The bioactive constituents of Trisetaria dufourei include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
